_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 07: 2024-09-23 to 2024-11-04. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw the balloon deflating and added his own reading that interest rates would come down, and states plainly that he missed it, then saw the housing market and a thin membrane shaking through the summer months.
mentions.quote: I thought the interest rates were coming down I missed it
mentions.falsify_match: A housing market break during the 2024 summer.
mentions.falsify_miss: No break, which he has already conceded for the rate half.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls being told an event would happen in October and being given a thirty day assignment to pray over the economy, and says that because much prayer went up from Washington and elsewhere he then saw great economic distress going into 2025.
mentions.quote: I saw going into uh 2025 that there would be great economic dis
mentions.condition_text: the change is tied to thirty days of intercession
mentions.falsify_match: Severe US economic distress during 2025.

mentions.claim_text: With the election called and Jerome Powell still running things, he says he still saw the house of cards fall, the economy fall, the dam busting, terrible times and a humbling coming for the United States, and the plague, without knowing whether it is January or later.
mentions.quote: I still saw the damn busting I still saw uh the the terrible times ahead
mentions.time_phrase: whether or not that is in January or whatever
mentions.falsify_match: A US financial collapse and a plague, at any point.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither occurs, though he attaches no date to fail against.

mentions.claim_text: Advice to find scripture and devotionals on a Bible app that minister to you and read them daily, because the word changes you from the inside out.
mentions.quote: when you read that word it becomes real inside of you
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: devotional advice.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is time to feed people the meat of the word so they can stand, and that woe to those who do not, because they will go home early and will not be able to stand.
mentions.quote: Woe to you that don't. You're gonna go home early
mentions.condition_text: survival tied to being fed the meat of the word
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: any death is attributable to not having stood.

mentions.claim_text: He says he has seen a great storm still on the horizon which may be delayed by some months or a year, and adds that depth perception in the spirit realm is something he is still learning.
mentions.quote: I see a storm on the horizon
mentions.condition_text: the delay is offered without a cause but alongside his usual prayer framing
mentions.time_phrase: delayed by some months, whether or not it's a year
mentions.falsify_match: A major crisis arriving within roughly a year.
mentions.falsify_miss: None arrives, though the delay clause absorbs that.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer on 31 October that a fire and urgency to preach come on believers, and that the demonic day be turned around for God's glory, refusing to be moved by Halloween.
mentions.quote: as we enter into this demonic day, we turn it around
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: intercession.

mentions.claim_text: He says that in October matters were weighed in the courts of heaven, that the prayers coming before God swayed the scales concerning the time frame, and that God is granting extended time of grace to bring forth revival.
mentions.quote: of time it was it's suade it in the heavenlies
mentions.condition_text: the extension is attributed to October intercession
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a granted extension leaves nothing observable.

mentions.claim_text: He says it was pushed down the road a little, then he saw a great collapse again, with calendars flipping from 2024 into 2025 and falling back to the 1930s for a great economic depression, this time with a debt crisis and a lending crisis in which the banks will not let anyone borrow.
mentions.quote: I saw it like it was falling backwards back to 1930s again
mentions.falsify_match: A depression-scale collapse with a credit freeze in which banks stop lending.
mentions.falsify_miss: No collapse and no lending freeze in that window.

mentions.claim_text: He reports that the antichrist agenda took a severe blow because his people prayed in October, and that he was shown the underground church in China and across Asia interceding on behalf of America over the election.
mentions.quote: the underground Church in China prayed
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: intercession by an underground church is not observable from outside.

mentions.claim_text: He prays a turnaround over Ted Cruz and the Senate race, declaring it will not go blue but red, and calls forth a flood of voters.
mentions.quote: it will not go blue but it will go red
mentions.falsify_match: Cruz holds the Texas Senate seat on 5 November 2024.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that hidden cells of people in America with ill intentions be exposed and brought to justice around the election, and that leaders be raised up to do it.
mentions.quote: Hidden cells of these people are here and we call an exposing
mentions.falsify_match: A terror cell exposed in the US around the November 2024 election.

mentions.claim_text: He says he prophesied a comet without knowing one was coming, and that the Lord warned him there will be more fearful signs in the heavens, including things with asteroids, stars and falling stars.
mentions.quote: there will be fearful signs in the heavens coming even more so
mentions.falsify_match: Notable comets, asteroid passes or meteor events treated as signs.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing unusual in the sky, though the category is broad enough that something usually qualifies.

mentions.claim_text: Answering viewers who say October was a nothing burger and that BRICS did not deliver, he says it is not over yet, that he had said October would be the beginning of something, and that he saw the bubble busting and told them to watch the financial sector.
mentions.quote: October's been a big nothing Burger you prophesied something was going to happen
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable as reframed: a missed month becomes the beginning of something with no end date.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer for a turn of votes, that righteous men and women come out to vote and that even the unrighteous vote for him.
mentions.quote: we will have a turn of votes father
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: intercession over turnout.

mentions.claim_text: He says what he took for a thirty day prayer assignment has been extended indefinitely, with the Lord telling him to pray continually until released.
mentions.quote: you will pray continually even after the 30 days until I release you
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an open-ended assignment.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer that the eyes of unsaved loved ones be enlightened against the blinding of Satan, resting on the promise that a child trained up will not depart from it even if wayward.
mentions.quote: the eyes of their understanding would be enlightened
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: intercession.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer that hard hearts become pliable and that wayward children call home today saying they want to be born again, wherever they are.
mentions.quote: they're calling today they're calling and saying Mom Dad
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: intercession.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that whatever was held behind the dam and was going to be released come December will be handled, and that God provides for his household regardless of the finances and however long the turnaround takes during the term.
mentions.quote: whatever they had behind that damn and what they were trying to release come
mentions.falsify_match: A release of withheld material or a financial event in December 2024.

mentions.claim_text: Answering those who say the October surprise never came, he redefines it: an October surprise is not a bad thing, the surprise is that the glory is here and something good is coming.
mentions.quote: an October surprise is surprise the glory is here
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable by construction: the sign of the prediction is reversed after the fact so that nothing happening counts as fulfilment.

mentions.claim_text: He anticipates the objection that no October surprise came and answers that God's surprises are not bad ones, asking how many times God has said surprise, something bad is happening.
mentions.quote: how many times has God said surprise something bad's happening
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: the same reversal, stated a day earlier.

mentions.claim_text: He says they knew the thing would happen but not whether it would be this year or next, and when it came they recognised it as the kickoff with the whistle blown and the clock set.
mentions.quote: we just didn't know if it was going to be this year or next year
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an undated expectation confirmed after the fact.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats a phrase from Billy Brim at the conference, oh what a plan, which he says has echoed in his spirit for days, and encourages viewers to watch the meeting.
mentions.quote: oh what a plan oh what a plan
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a phrase he found striking.

mentions.claim_text: Teaching that faith and healing are not feelings any more than salvation is, so an absence of felt change does not mean you are not healed.
mentions.quote: faith and healing is not a feeling. Neither is salvation
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it explains why: the outcome is defined so that no observation can bear on it.

mentions.claim_text: Healing prayer naming arthritis, glaucoma, clogged arteries coming unclogged, new brains against dementia, and creative miracles including arms growing out.
mentions.quote: for creative miracles in the body, for arms growing out right now
mentions.falsify_match: A documented limb regrowth would be decisive; it is prayed for, not reported.

mentions.claim_text: He declares that they will go into 2025 with a fresh clean start, that the storm will not hit as he saw it and the financial storm will be averted, and speaks that there will not be a financial crisis, petitioning as Abraham did.
mentions.quote: the storm will not hit like I saw. That the financial storm will be averted
mentions.condition_text: he is expressly using authority to cancel what he saw
mentions.falsify_match: No US financial crisis in 2025, which he would claim as the answer to this prayer.
mentions.falsify_miss: A crisis arrives despite the declaration.

mentions.claim_text: The Lord tells him this is how they are going to run their campaign in 2024 and to tell people to pray and listen for guidance about every place they go, especially major events, crowds and concerts.
mentions.quote: This is how they're going to run their campaign in 2024
mentions.falsify_match: Attacks at US mass gatherings used as a campaign tactic in late 2024.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer for one last call for a harvest of souls, a fair election on 5 November and a landslide victory in the House, the Senate and the presidency.
mentions.quote: it will be a landslide Victory a landslide victory in the house the Senate
mentions.falsify_match: Republicans take the presidency, Senate and House in November 2024.
mentions.falsify_miss: Any of the three goes the other way.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that the election be settled within a couple of days rather than weeks, with the Holy Spirit and angels at the polling stations.
mentions.quote: we'll know within a couple of days right after the election
mentions.falsify_match: The 2024 result is settled within a couple of days of the vote.

mentions.claim_text: He says the great tribulation is coming and the birthing pains over the next year will intensify beyond anybody's comprehension, that people will see what they never thought they would see, and that believers were not called to escape but to be warriors.
mentions.quote: The birthing pains over this next year are going to intensify
mentions.falsify_match: The year to October 2025 is marked by extraordinary and unprecedented events.

mentions.claim_text: Closing thanks for what God has done since July the 11th, with a note about the treasure in earthen vessels and an invitation to new viewers.
mentions.quote: thank you Jesus for all that he's done even in this year since July
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: sign-off.

mentions.claim_text: Teaching that it is time to move from milk to meat, to get teeth and a backbone, because the devil cannot devour someone founded on the word.
mentions.quote: it's time for you to get some teeth and a backbone
mentions.condition_text: protection tied to having the word as a foundation
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching.

mentions.claim_text: The Lord tells him he wants people to believe for bigger, and he says 2024 is not over for anyone still believing for something that looks impossible.
mentions.quote: Brandon I want them to believe me for bigger 2024 is not over yet
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: private outcomes with a faith condition.

mentions.claim_text: He says that after Rosh Hashanah the Lord told him it would be a time of great acceleration in weather, signs in the heavens, earthquakes and wars and rumours of wars, and that it is going to increase by three times.
mentions.quote: Brandon it's going to increase by three times
mentions.falsify_match: A roughly threefold rise in significant quakes, extreme weather and conflicts after October 2024.
mentions.falsify_miss: Rates stay flat, which is checkable against public records.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls the dam warning given around March of the previous year as something serious to pray over, and mentions a friend texting him that Trump was going to hold a rally at Coachella.
mentions.quote: like March or so of last year and the Lord told me to start praying
mentions.time_phrase: March or so of last year
mentions.falsify_match: Dates the origin of the dam thread to March 2023, checkable against the March 2023 videos.

mentions.claim_text: He says there are certain things he knows about October to pray over, and asks for hedges of protection over Trump and over bystanders and attendees at the event so that no weapon formed against them prospers.
mentions.quote: there's certain things that I know about October to pray
mentions.falsify_match: An attempt on Trump or on a crowd at one of his October 2024 rallies.

mentions.claim_text: An altar call that today is the day for salvation and healing rather than tomorrow, since Jesus is coming and tomorrow is not guaranteed.
mentions.quote: Today is your day for salvation. Today is your day for healing
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: altar call.

mentions.claim_text: Thanks to supporters for making it possible to minister worldwide, and a note that he will be at a healing meeting in Collinsville.
mentions.quote: You've made a dream come true to be able to minister Jesus
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: sign-off.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying a shaking is coming and a storm is coming upon these shores, and that everything anyone has ever known will change within a twenty four hour period, that quickly.
mentions.quote: everything that you've ever known ladies and gentlemen will change within a 24-hour period
mentions.falsify_match: A single day on which American life changes comprehensively.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such day, though no date is given for it.

mentions.claim_text: He describes weeping in his spirit for families with special needs children and praying for them with more compassion than for anyone else, because he has walked through that pain himself.
mentions.quote: my spirit weeps for them with the compassion that I have towards families
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: personal testimony.
